user.title: Connect to Smart Home
user.description: Create a pairing code in the Smart Home app under Gateways → Pair Home Assistant, then enter the app address and the code here.

data_description.url: The address shown next to the code, e.g. https://smart.example.org
data_description.code: 8 characters, e.g. ABCD-EFGH; valid for 15 minutes

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again
reauth_confirm.description: The Smart Home app no longer accepts the key of this Home Assistant. In the app, choose Pair again for this gateway and enter the new code here.

data_description.code: 8 characters, e.g. ABCD-EFGH; valid for 15 minutes

error.invalid_url: This is not a valid address. Enter it like https://smart.example.org.
error.insecure_url: The address must start with https://. http:// is only allowed for localhost, private IP addresses and names without a dot.
error.invalid_code: The code is unknown, expired or already used. Create a new code in the app.
error.other_gateway: This code belongs to another gateway. In the app, choose Pair again for this gateway, or remove the integration and add it again.
error.limit_reached: This household already has the maximum number of Home Assistant gateways. Revoke one in the app first.
error.unavailable: The app cannot pair right now. Try again in a few minutes.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the app. Check the address and the network.

abort.already_configured: This gateway is already set up.
